test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

She will have participate / in the dance competition / by the time her father / returns from the tour.
solution:
The erroneous part is** 'She will have participate'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The segment that contains a grammatical error is:** She will have participate. **
 
• The correct form of the verb should be in the** past participle form, which is "participated." **The corrected segment should read: ***"She will have participated."***
 
• Explanation: The **verb** "**participate**" is incorrectly used in **the present tense form "participate" **instead of** the past participle form "participated"** following **the auxiliary verb** "**have**."
 
• In this context, **the past participle form **is needed to convey the completion of the action.

 

**Correct Sentence:__** ***She will have participated **in the dance competition by the time her father returns from the tour.*
